title: Toward Automatic Group Membership Annotation for Group Fairness Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Using text classification models (such as BERT, GPT, and Mistral) to automatically annotate the gender of document subjects (e.g., male, female, non-binary) and evaluating the impact of these automated annotations on exposure-based group fairness metrics (like Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness and Expected Exposure Disparity) in information retrieval rankings.

Predicting the geographic location or country of origin associated with documents using language models, and assessing how automated geographic group membership annotations correlate with human annotations when measuring rank fairness and exposure disparity across different regional groups.
